author: ruixen.ui
name: credit-card-hero
description: The CreditCardHero component is a premium advertising-style showcase designed for modern fintech or banking landing pages. At its core, it combines clean, centered marketing content—a bold headline, descriptive subtext, and a clear call-to-action button—with two floating 3D credit cards that sit outside the content area, one larger at the bottom-left and one smaller at the top-right. The cards subtly tilt with cursor movement, giving the layout depth and a dynamic, interactive feel while ensuring the text remains fully visible and unobstructed. This separation of visuals and copy creates a billboard-like hero section, perfect for capturing user attention in a professional yet engaging way. Its minimal, polished design makes it well-suited for advertising new credit products, digital banking features, or promotional campaigns where trust, style, and clarity are equally important.
